name: br.com.mrocigno.bigbrother.report.crash.CrashTask
description: This is part of Mrocigno's BigBrother diagnostic toolkit. As app screens resume, this older BigBrother task registers a handler for uncaught crashes; a crash opens the report screen.
disableEffect: The older BigBrother crash handler and report screen will no longer run; the app's existing crash handler remains in place.
